title: Seven-Day Pact
next_chapter_hook: Before Ye Qing could finish her words, a deafening roar echoed from the distance, as if something was breaking free from its seal—and that aura strangely resonated with the Tianji Record within Chen Ji's body.

text.content: In the deafening roar of the shattered seal, Chen Ji felt the surrounding spiritual energy suddenly stagnate, as if an invisible hand had gripped his throat. That aura surging from the depths surpassed anything he had ever sensed—not pressure, but something more primordial, like the chaotic whispers of creation.

dialogue.content: Step back!

text.content: Ye Qing's voice exploded beside Chen Ji's ear, and the next moment, a cold hand had seized his wrist, yanking him backward. Chen Ji stumbled and glimpsed within that cracked fissure some black mist slowly seeping out, and wherever it passed, even space emitted an unbearable wail.

dialogue.content: What is that?

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the surging qi and blood, his gaze rapidly sweeping across that abyss-like fissure. The Tianji Record Fragment in his mental sea was trembling wildly, as if issuing a warning—or yearning for something. He firmly noted this anomaly but revealed nothing on his face.

dialogue.content: Something sealed by the Holy Sect... that should not awaken.

text.content: Ye Qing released his hand, her jet-black hair fluttering violently in the pervasive chaotic aura. Her expression was uncommonly grave, yet her gaze remained fixed on Chen Ji, as if reassessing him. After a long pause, she suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a solemnity Chen Ji had never heard before.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I know what you're thinking. As the Demonic Holy Maiden appearing at the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds, you assume I must have ulterior motives.

text.content: Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, not denying it. Ye Qing's words were frank—frank enough to catch him off guard. He calmly straightened his wrinkled sleeve, his tone as casual as discussing the weather.

dialogue.content: Since Your Highness knows, daring to say it aloud must mean you have筹码 weighty enough to back it up.

text.content: A flash of appreciation crossed Ye Qing's eyes before she resumed her cold, distant demeanor. She slightly turned aside, her back to the still-spreading fissure, her voice echoing through the empty core area.

dialogue.content: Within the Demonic Holy Sect, there is a mysterious commander. This person's identity is an enigma, not even Holy Sect elders have the right to know their true appearance. But I discovered some... things that should not have been discovered.

text.content: She paused, turning to meet Chen Ji's gaze directly, her words astonishing.

dialogue.content: That commander is connected to the Tianji Record. One might even say—he is also searching for the complete form of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat, but his expression remained unruffled. In his mental sea, the Tianji Record Fragment seemed to sense something, emitting an eerie glow. On the surface he showed nothing, but internally, turbulent waves were crashing—A Demonic Path commander connected to the Tianji Record? This game was far more complex than he imagined.

dialogue.content: So?

text.content: Chen Ji uttered only two words, his tone so flat it revealed no emotion whatsoever. Ye Qing seemed prepared for exactly this response, her lips curving slightly upward, yet carrying a trace of bitterness.

dialogue.content: Therefore, I need your help.
She took a deep breath, as if weighing her words carefully. A moment later, her voice was low and firm, each word seemingly深思熟虑.

In seven days, the confrontation between the three major sects and the Demonic Path will reach a critical juncture. Before then, I need you to cooperate with me to jointly uncover the complete secrets of Chen Xuan's remains. In exchange—I will give you all the intelligence I possess about that mysterious commander, without reservation.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's筹码 was already substantial, but cooperating with the Demonic Holy Maiden was no different from dancing with a tiger. Chen Ji rapidly calculated the pros and cons in his mind, his expression still serene.

choices.description: Ye Qing's intelligence held immense value. Though allying with the Demonic Holy Maiden carried tremendous risk, the rewards were equally substantial. Chen Ji decided to accept first, then wait for the right moment to act.
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence from within the Demonic Path and clues about the mysterious commander
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by the righteous path of colluding with the Demonic Path, reputation would be ruined

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he stood with hands behind his back, his gaze shifting between the fissure still emanating chaotic aura and Ye Qing. After a long moment, he smiled lightly, but the笑意 did not reach his eyes.

dialogue.content: Seven-Day Pact? Sounds interesting enough. However—shouldn't Your Highness first show some sincerity?

choices.description: Ye Qing spoke beautifully, but who knows if this was just another trap? Chen Ji decided to first probe her bottom line before making a decision.
choices.visible_cost: May miss out on intelligence source
choices.visible_reward: Probe for more information from the other party
choices.risk_hint: If too cautious, may alert the other party
choices.process_label: 不置可否，要求对方先亮底牌

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, looking at Ye Qing with a knowing smile. His silence itself was a form of pressure, preventing the other party from judging what he was truly thinking. The atmosphere in the air suddenly tensed.

dialogue.content: Your Highness's bait is indeed tempting. But—why should I believe this isn't another layout by the Holy Sect?

choices.description: Directly inquire about details regarding the mysterious commander and why she chose him as a cooperation partner—Chen Ji wanted to clarify her true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: May expose what one cares about
choices.risk_hint: Pressing too deep may触及the other party's unwilling secrets

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a flash of sharpness disappearing in an instant. He neither refused nor agreed, but instead asked an even sharper question.

dialogue.content: Regarding this mysterious commander Your Highness mentioned—if it's Holy Sect core intelligence, how did you come to know they're connected to the Tianji Record? Could it be—Your Highness yourself is a piece on their board?

text.content: Hearing this, Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly. It seemed she hadn't expected Chen Ji to so directly pierce the crucial point. After several breaths of silence, she slowly spoke.

dialogue.content: ...You're right. I was indeed his person once. Or rather—I have always been a piece in his hand. But I discovered some... things that should not have been discovered.

text.content: She extended her hand, and a jade slip glowing with a faint幽光 appeared in her palm. The jade slip was pitch-black, yet its surface flowed with golden patterns remarkably similar to the Tianji Record Fragment. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that was...

dialogue.content: This is what I spent three years窃取from the Holy Sect forbidden grounds. Clues to what might be Tianji Record fragments, and part of that mysterious commander's past. Handing it to you is... my oath of allegiance.

choice.prompt: A clue to a potential Tianji Record fragment lay before him, Chen Ji's heart churned, but his expression remained unmoved. Was this an opportunity to pursue the complete Tianji Record, or another elaborately designed trap?

choices.text: Accept the clue and finalize the Seven-Day Pact
choices.description: Regardless of whether it's a trap, this fragment clue is worth the risk. The Seven-Day Pact is hereby finalized, and cooperation officially begins.
choices.visible_cost: Formally establish a cooperative relationship with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain clues to Tianji Record fragments, begin investigation in seven days
choices.risk_hint: Once news leaks, the righteous path will certainly rise to attack
choices.process_label: 收下玉简，确认合作细节

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, reaching out to accept the jade slip. The moment it touched his hand, a familiar aura flowed from his fingertips into his mental sea, and the Tianji Record Fragment unexpectedly emitted a faint hum. His gaze darkened slightly as he tucked the jade slip into his sleeve.

dialogue.content: Very well. In seven days, I will send someone to contact Your Highness. Before then—you and I have never met.
Of course.

choices.description: This jade slip is too suspicious. Chen Ji decided not to take this risk. He'd rather miss the opportunity than let evidence fall into others' hands.
choices.visible_cost: Miss out on Tianji Record fragment clues
choices.visible_reward: Avoid being drawn into Demonic Path schemes
choices.risk_hint: May cause Ye Qing to become suspicious
choices.process_label: 婉拒玉简，保留独立行动权

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach for the jade slip. Instead, he stepped back, standing with hands behind his back. His gaze fell on Ye Qing's face, his expression cold and indifferent, as if looking at a stranger.

dialogue.content: Your Highness's kindness, Chen Ji appreciates. But such things of unknown origin, Chen Ji dares not easily accept.

text.content: Ye Qing withdrew the jade slip, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of her lips. She did not insist, simply tucking the jade slip back into her sleeve, then turning to face the slowly spreading fissure. Chaotic aura surged more intensely, and the entire core area trembled slightly.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, let me add one more thing. The Tianji Record Fragment in your body should have warned you of your impending death more than once, right?

text.content: These words hit like a basin of ice water over Chen Ji's head. His fingertips stiffened for an instant, but his expression remained as calm as still water, as if Ye Qing was merely discussing the weather. Yet his left hand hanging at his side had already secretly clenched into a fist.

dialogue.content: What does Your Highness mean by this?

text.content: Ye Qing did not look back, yet her voice clearly entered Chen Ji's ears.

dialogue.content: Three months. You have three months left. That mysterious commander... has been waiting for this moment. I can only say this much.

text.content: Her words fell, and Ye Qing's figure dissolved into a wisp of black smoke, merging into the pervasive chaotic mist. Only her final words lingered, echoing through the empty core area.

dialogue.content: In seven days, at the abandoned spiritual mine three hundred li to the southeast. I will wait for you there. By then, you will know more of the answers you seek.

text.content: Chen Ji stood alone, the surrounding chaotic aura still surging. He lowered his head to look at his left hand, where the fist he had just clenched had slowly relaxed. The Tianji Record Fragment in his mental sea lay dormant, yet seemed heavier than before. Three months... How did Ye Qing know? What exactly was the background of that mysterious commander behind her?

He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his scattered thoughts. Whether Ye Qing's words were true or false, he had to keep this Seven-Day Pact. In seven days, three hundred li to the southeast, the abandoned spiritual mine—he would take the first step in formally allying with the Demonic Holy Maiden, and step into an even more unfathomable vortex. In the distance, that fissure continued slowly expanding, as if something was awakening from slumber. And Chen Ji knew—his chess game had just begun.
